what: NEXT-0's survey after P-BANDS, on the tree before POOL-AFFINITY (ca11155d2f5a3cfd9668c715216ab67d96f4898c), and the levers it measured and did not take, each against that tree's unit; survey.sh ran them serially, every build -std=c11 -O3 -ffp-contract=off -fno-math-errno -pthread (clang)

parts.what: ../../2026-10-23/bwd-keep/step_parts.py (12 rounds) from the tree before's own checkout, at T256, T512 and T1024 on four threads and T512 on one: each job's nanoseconds summed by its claim name, the median over the rounds

parts_first.what: NEXT-0's first reading of the same (step_parts.py, 12 rounds, 8 on one thread, the same tree before), the reading that placed the slice and that the code commit's message quotes; survey.sh's parts above are its second

forward_phases.what: fwd_bench.c over instrument_fwd.py's copy of the unit (thread-local TSC counters around the banded stored forward's phases: tq, scores, softmax, context, zero, head): args B T H KH D THREADS ROUNDS CONTRACT, three interleaved repetitions; wall TSC cycles a call and each phase's cycles summed over the threads a call

forward_resident.what: fwd_micro.c: the banded forward's group kernels (scores, softmax, context; the unit #included) on cache-resident operands, one 16-row group at R with d channels, each phase timed alone, TSC cycles a probability (the median of REPS calls) for each of THREADS copies run at once

forward_cold.what: fwd_cold.c: one 16-row group's phases in sequence, its slot in a pool of POOL MiB a thread -- mode 0 the same slot each call, 1 a new slot each call (cold, as a stored head's bands are), 2 computed in a resident scratch slot and streamed out with non-temporal stores, 3 copied out with ordinary stores (the same values); TSC cycles a probability by phase

pool_cost.what: pool_cost.c: JOBS back-to-back pool_run calls of TASKS empty tasks and of tasks that spin WORK_NS each, and the elementwise jobs at one shape back to back on the same pool; the median microseconds a job

elementwise_cold.what: ew_cold.c on the tree before's unit: the RMSNorm, its VJP with the residual add and the residual add warm (back to back), cold (a 256 MiB read before each call) and after a pool job wrote their operands; the median microseconds of 15 calls

gemm_gap.what: gemm_b2b.c: one k-blocked GEMM shape CALLS times back to back, then each call after a GAP_US pause (the pool's workers asleep when it starts); the median of ROUNDS rounds of the mean call

exp8.what: EXP8-0 (proto_exp8.py): the banded group softmax evaluating EXPW columns of a block at once through exp1_512n (8) where the tree takes four, fwd_micro.c built at EXPW 4 and 8 on four threads, three interleaved repetitions; summary: each phase's TSC cycles a probability, the mean over the threads, the median over the repetitions

attention_prototypes.what: ../p-bands/ab_bands.c, the tree before's unit (base) against each prototype (proto) and base again (A/A) in one process, B4/T2048, 4 heads of 32, four threads, contract 49, 32 rounds: pfw (proto_fwd.py: FWD-BANDW-0, the next band prefetched for writing while a group computes), nt (proto_fwd.py: each group computed in a resident scratch and streamed out with non-temporal stores), sweep (proto_bwd.py: BWD-SWEEP-0, dV and dK inside the groups' sweep), pf_walk (proto_pf.py: BWD-PF-0, P's lines prefetched in the banded walks); every prototype's outputs the unit's

backward_phase_prototypes.what: bwd_phase.c over instrument_sweep.py's copies (thread-local TSC counters around the banded backward's phases: dV's walk, the groups -- or, in the sweep, its two passes -- dQ, dK's walk), B4/T2048, 4 heads of 32, four threads, 8 rounds, three interleaved repetitions: the tree before, sweep, and pf_walk, pf_group, pf_both (proto_pf.py: P's lines prefetched in the walks, in the groups, or both); TSC cycles a probability (x threads); checks: dq, dk and dv at fixed indices, one set each

wadj_tile.what: WADJ-TILE-0 (proto_wadj.py, WADJ_RR=64: the weight adjoints' rows in ranges of 64 for more tasks) against the tree before's unit, ../../2026-10-23/mm-rows/ab_gemm.c, 16 rounds, the pair, group and weight-adjoint jobs at 1,024, 2,048 and 8,192 rows
